statements.quote: SRS is recommended for patients with a limited number (1-4) of BMs [EANO: I, A; ESMO: I, A].
statements.evidence: EANO: I, A; ESMO: I, A
statements.applies_because_cs: Jediné ložisko podezřelé z metastázy (počet 1, tedy v rozmezí 1-4). Metastáza zatím není potvrzena.

patient_facts.text: MR mozku 14. 9. 2026: solitární sytící se ložisko v pravé hemisféře mozečku do 3 mm, susp. metastáza

statements.evidence_cs: doporučení · EANO I A / ESMO I A

statements.quote: Factors favouring SRS alone over surgery commonly followed by SRS or systemic therapy include a surgically less accessible location, increased surgical risk and preference for a noninvasive outpatient treatment.
statements.applies_because_cs: Věta srovnává SRS s chirurgickou léčbou (ne se sledováním). Ložisko v pravé hemisféře mozečku do 3 mm je suspektní z metastázy; dostupnost pro operaci a operační riziko dokumentace nehodnotí.

ECOG PS 1, bez klinických známek mozkových metastáz (občasné mžitky před očima)

statements.quote: For patients with asymptomatic or oligosymptomatic BM, no prospective trials have addressed the question of optimal combined modality treatment with systemic therapy, including TKI or immune checkpoint inhibition, and surgery or SRS.
statements.applies_because_cs: Onkolog zapsal ‚bez klin. známek mozkových mts‘; pacient uvádí občasné mžitky před očima, jejich souvislost s ložiskem dokumentace nehodnotí. Pacient je na systémové léčbě (everolimus od 3. 9. 2026).

statements.quote: Ideally, therapeutic decisions should be discussed at a dedicated BM board or at a disease-specific tumour board with participation of colleagues experienced in the management of CNS tumours [EANO: IV, n/a; ESMO: V, B].

statements.applies_because_cs: Primární nádor: světlobuněčný karcinom ledviny G2; dvě předchozí linie systémové léčby (nivolumab + ipilimumab, sunitinib), nyní 3. linie everolimus.

1. linie nivolumab + ipilimumab, progrese (iRECIST potvrzena 1/2026)
2. linie sunitinib 1-8/2026, progrese
Everolimus 5 mg denně od 3. 9. 2026 (3. linie); dle nejnovějšího ambulantního závěru navýšení na 10 mg denně od 19. 9. 2026

statements.quote: In the situations of multiple systemic treatment options, CNS and extra-CNS disease activity as well as toxicity profile of the respective treatment options should be considered in the decision-making process for the optimal systemic treatment strategy [EANO: IV, A; ESMO: IV, B].
statements.evidence: EANO: IV, A; ESMO: IV, B
statements.applies_because_cs: Vedle ložiska v mozečku (suspekce na metastázu) uvádí dokumentace aktivní extrakraniální onemocnění: dle CT 8/2026 velikostní progrese uzlin v levém plicním hilu a v retroperitoneu paraaortálně vlevo. Histologicky ověřené metastázy v paraaortální uzlině (exstirpace 10/2022) a v kůži brady (excize 11/2023) byly v minulosti odstraněny. CT AG plicnice 10. 2. 2026 popisuje drobná osteoplastická ložiska v přechodu Th/L; jejich povahu dokumentace neuvádí. Pacient je ve 3. linii systémové léčby (everolimus).

pages.text: Recommendations Surgery  Surgery should be considered when there is doubt on the neoplastic nature of a brain lesion, when no primary tumour is known, when more than one tumour is known, when the primary tumour rarely generates BM or when changes in molecular profile compared with the primary tumour may impact clinical decision making [EANO: III, C; ESMO: IV, B]. […] Radiotherapy  SRS is recommended for patients with a limited number (1-4) of BMs [EANO: I, A; ESMO: I, A].  SRS may be considered for patients with a higher number of BMs (5-10) with a cumulative tumour volume <15 ml [EANO: II, B; ESMO: II, B].  SRS to the resection cavity is recommended after complete or incomplete resection of BMs [EANO: I, A; ESMO: I, A]. […] Pharmacotherapy  Systemic pharmacotherapy based on histological and molecular characteristics of the primary tumour and previous treatment should be considered for most patients with BMs [EANO: IV, n/a; ESMO: IV, B].

Ideally, therapeutic decisions should be discussed at a dedicated BM board or at a disease-specific tumour board with participation of colleagues experienced in the management of CNS tumours [EANO: IV, n/a; ESMO: V, B]. […] The following factors favour neurosurgical resection: unknown primary tumour, neuroradiologically uncertain lesion, large cystic or necrotic lesion, need for high-dose steroids, mass effect and need for molecular profiling to guide clinical decision making. Factors favouring SRS alone over surgery commonly followed by SRS or systemic therapy include a surgically less accessible location, increased surgical risk and preference for a noninvasive outpatient treatment. […] BRAF inhibitors and WBRT cause severe dermatitis that is usually managed by avoiding concomitant treatment.75 For patients with asymptomatic or oligosymptomatic BM, no prospective trials have addressed the question of optimal combined modality treatment with systemic therapy, including TKI or immune checkpoint inhibition, and surgery or SRS.

Volume 32 - Issue 11 - 2021 Annals of Oncology  Neurocognitive function and ability to consent should be regularly assessed [EANO: IV, n/a; ESMO: IV, B].  Brain MRI should be carried out every 2-3 months or at any instance of suspected neurological progression [EANO: IV, C; ESMO: IV, B].  Advanced MRI techniques, such as MRS and perfusion imaging and amino acid PET, should be considered for distinguishing treatment-related changes from tumour progression [EANO: III, C; ESMO: IV, C].

In the situations of multiple systemic treatment options, CNS and extra-CNS disease activity as well as toxicity profile of the respective treatment options should be considered in the decision-making process for the optimal systemic treatment strategy [EANO: IV, A; ESMO: IV, B].
Kabozantinib (2A) Everolimus (2A) Dosud nepoužitý VEGF-TKI (2B) Belzutifan (2B) Lenvatinib a everolimus (2B) Nivolumab (1) Kabozantinib (1) Everolimus (1) Dosud nepoužitý VEGF-TKI (2B)
U nemocných s mRCC by mělo být zvažováno zařazení do klinické studie. […] Počet linií léčby mRCC by neměl být limitován jinak než stavem nemocného a dostupností léků (2A).

Chirurgická léčba metastáz je doporučena v případě možnosti jejich kompletního odstranění a zvážení přínosu vs. operační zátěže (úroveň důkazů 2A), alternativou může být využití lokálně ablativních metod (např. SBRT).
